NBA Overnight Notes — Oct 31

Trail Blazers 112, Jazz 90
Ja Morant – out with no timeline from Micah Nori; Portland will miss him most on turnovers
Yang Hansen – extended minutes with Donovan Clingan in foul trouble; Nori says things are "starting to slow down for him"

76ers 109, Hornets 104
LeBron James – sat out along with Joel Embiid; no reason given, VJ Edgecombe confirmed both absences
Jabari Walker – returned for 20 minutes backing up Joel Embiid; Nurse said "the 4-5 was a little thin"

Pelicans 121, Hawks 99
Dejounte Murray – out again "for similar reasons," per Jamahl Mosley; Herb Jones and Jeremiah Fears started
Zion Williamson – suggested mid-game he be more a screener than handler; Mosley pairs him late with Jeremiah Fears

Grizzlies 136, Kings 105
Javon Small – ran the second unit with two unnamed guards out, after barely playing in the first five games
Cam Spencer – played point guard with two guards out; 13 assists and 0 turnovers

Cavaliers 136, Bucks 111
Meleek Thomas – kenny Atkinson's third ball handler six games into his rookie season; says the staff's confidence "means everything"
Brayden Burries – drew the Donovan Mitchell assignment; called it "a good challenge" as a rookie

Spurs 121, Timberwolves 111
Rudy Gobert – did not play on the second night of a back-to-back; no reason given
LaMelo Ball – picked up six fouls; Finch says opponents bump, hold and ride him full court

Rockets 119, Thunder 98
Alperen Sengun – returned from a lower-back flare-up; Udoka says it came from taking a charge, not a recurring injury
Fred VanVleet – out on the back-to-back after surgery, as planned; Marcus Smart started in his place

Best of the night:

"I thought we got rid of that stuff in the '80s, but apparently not."
– Chris Finch on opponents bumping and holding LaMelo Ball full court

"He's earned that right. He's deserved that right. And that's on me."
– Micah Nori on not playing Yang Hansen against Memphis

"I've made 1,000-some 3-pointers, you know, I have confidence I'll make 1,000 more."
– Myles Turner on shooting through the Bucks' slump

Every note, game by game: https://t.co/CDZrdvvl94
